inside_common: Nothing here needs a database, a server, or a paid n8n tier.
Every workflow ships inactive. You read the config table before anything runs.
Every kit includes a rollback guide, because you will want one eventually.
Twelve months of workflow fixes included. Platform API changes are documented.
steps: n8n menu, Import from File. The workflow lands inactive.
Two or three placeholder URLs and keys. The setup doc lists every one.
One copy-paste curl command. You see the result before it nears a customer.
Flip the switch. The first execution waits in the Executions panel.
faq: Do I need to know how to code?
No. You replace strings in a configuration panel. The only code is already written inside the workflow nodes, and you can read it — it is commented.
Will this work on the free n8n tier?
Yes. Nothing here depends on paid features, external queues, or a database.
What if a platform changes its API and a workflow breaks?
Within twelve months of purchase, send me the error and I ship a fix. I do not promise zero breakage — I promise the fix is free.
The checkout provider's standard refund policy applies. If you cannot import the file at all, tell me and I fix it before you ask for money back.
Why is there no auto-publish step in the content kit?
Language models can write; they cannot vouch for facts. The review gate is the product, not an unfinished feature.
